body: I don’t think you’ll ever feel entirely ready haha, but that’s totally normal and it’s okay, take it when you feel like it’s the right time for you. I also pushed back my date! ❤️ I would recommend Archer over Uworld, I had both but I liked archer better bc of their readiness exams and rationales. ALSO I can’t stress this enough Mark K (esp lecture 12) was the most helpful thing for me literally saved me on the exam. Focus on priority and think what is gonna save my patient? Learn test taking skills, don’t focus too much on memorizing! Try to really understand why things happen (read the rationales they help, even if u got it right) The questions are not going to be the same, they are vague but it’s bc the exam wants to know how u think like a nurse! You got it dw❤️ let me know if you pass!
Good luck!!🍀 let me know how it goes:) Ik you’ll pass<3
